name: taobao-script-search
description: Pure HTTP MTOP client for Taobao product queries (no browser, no daemon)
author: xiahao-china

scripts.test: npm run build && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test .runtime/test-build/tools/mtop-local.test.js .runtime/test-build/tools/shop-search.test.js .runtime/test-build/tools/cli-and-pipeline.test.js
scripts.pkg: npm run build && node tools/package-skill.mjs && powershell -NoProfile -Command "Compress-Archive -Path .runtime/skill-stage/taobao-product-search -DestinationPath dist/taobao-product-search.zip -Force"
